claims.evidence: Photo 0-2 show a truck-mounted derrick/mast rig consistent with a drilling machine
No video or photo showing the engine running, rig operating, or drilling in action

risks.risk: Engine may not start or run properly
risks.proof: Video of engine cold-start and idling, with dashboard/gauges visible

risks.risk: Drilling rig mechanism (derrick, winch, hydraulics) may be non-functional
risks.proof: Video of mast raising/lowering and drill rotation under power
Photo of odometer and engine hour meter

risks.risk: No maintenance or service history available
risks.if_unproven: priced as unmaintained, needing full service

risks.proof: Chassis/VIN plate photo or registration document showing year
risks.if_unproven: priced as oldest plausible model for this rig type

risks.risk: Possible mechanical or hydraulic faults not visible in static photos
risks.proof: Close-up photos/video of hydraulic hoses, pump, and leak points under operation
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming hydraulic system needs repair

risks.risk: Registration and ownership documents not verified
risks.proof: Photo of vehicle registration/ownership papers matching plate number
risks.if_unproven: priced as undocumented, with legal transfer risk

risks.risk: Completeness of rig components and tools uncertain
risks.proof: Full inventory photo of drill bits, pipes, and accessories included in sale
risks.if_unproven: priced as rig only, excluding tooling

risks.risk: Fuel type and consumption unverified, affecting running cost
risks.proof: Photo of fuel tank/label or manual page specifying fuel type
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming diesel with average consumption, no efficiency premium

proof_requests: Video of engine starting and running
Video of drill mast raising, lowering, and rotating under power
Photo of odometer and engine hour meter
Photo of VIN/chassis plate and registration documents
Photo of full tool/accessory set included in sale
Close-up photos of hydraulic lines and any visible leaks or rust
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a truck-mounted drilling rig, so it can be priced, but functional claims like 'working fine' are unverifiable remotely and must be priced at worst case until operational proof is provided.
